note: FOURTH SPP KEEPER, PROMOTED 2026-09-09 (lane SPP-51c) over keeper-3 (lane SPP-43, FINDING-spp-43-2026-09-07.md) BY OWNER RULING in-session, verbatim: 'Is this a recommended keeper candidate? If so plz promote. If structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper.' THE SESSION HAD RECOMMENDED AGAINST PROMOTION and that recommendation is not withdrawn or re-scored -- see WHAT THE OWNER OVERRODE below. THE RUN: keeper-3's recipe plus EXACTLY ONE gated field, vre_curtailment_oversupply_allocation=True, solved as ONE --year 2023 2024 2025 invocation, years sequential (rules 12 / 16). WHAT THE FIELD DOES -- it re-allocates the HOURS of SPP's measured wind curtailment and changes NO annual total. SPP's renewable bound was delivered_EIA930(t)/(1-0.096501), a FLAT per-hour gross-up verified flat to 99.94/99.93/99.98 % of hours; delivered is already NET of curtailment, so the measured 9.65 % was spread uniformly across all 8,760 hours -- everywhere except where it happened -- and the LP re-curtailed 0.0003-0.0017 %, printing 0-7 negative hours a year against ~1,000 measured while the price-formation path was already correct (wind_mc = -$26.000/MWh). The field water-fills the SAME frozen annual energy onto the lowest-net-load hours -- NL(t) = load - delivered wind - delivered solar -- capped by the fleet's own online capacity, at the level lambda that makes the annual identity hold. ZERO NEW FREE PARAMETERS (rule 21 [R-DOF], DOF ledger UNCHANGED from keeper-3 at 3 entries / 1 residual): lambda is not chosen, it is the unique root of that identity, and it is REPORTED (16.15/16.48/17.58 GW) never set. Rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]: the SPP-32 measured rate is untouched and annual wind potential is IDENTICAL to the flat rule's in every year (114.0552/120.9925/122.2552 TWh). Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]: it REPLACES the flat gross-up at the one seam that builds the bound. Rule 25 [R-ISO-SCOPE]: ISO-agnostic, no per-ISO number, default OFF, so all six other ISOs' keepers replay byte-identical and keep their cache keys. SECOND CHANGE IN THIS RUN'S SCORED BASIS, AN INPUT REPAIR RATHER THAN A MODEL CHANGE (rule 14 [R-ACCURATE]): the committed SPP actual-LMP sidecar was indexed on SPP's GMT market interval while the model's 8760 calendar is FIXED Central Standard Time, so C3a's hour-matched rt_lw had been scoring against a series SIX HOURS out of phase. Repaired by a pure re-indexing -- sorted value set identical, equal-hour annual mean unchanged to four decimals -- with the direction and the constant +6 fixed by physical markers (EIA-930 solar noon at index 12/13, load peak 17, the sidecar's own peak 22/23) and by SPP's own GMT-stamped GenMix load, NEVER by a residual. A six-ISO census isolates the defect to SPP alone. rt_lw 24.438/24.531/27.957 -> 25.133/25.450/28.598. THE DASHBOARD'S SPP ACTUALS AND EVERY SPP C3a/C3b NUMBER OLDER THAN 2026-09-09 ARE ON THE UNREPAIRED CLOCK AND ARE NOT COMPARABLE TO THESE. WHY IT IS THE KEEPER -- all three runs RE-SCORED on the SAME repaired bench, so this is like-for-like and not a basis artifact: C1 failing rows keeper-3 TWO (2024 CC_REGULAR -8.60, CT_PEAKER +9.94) / SPP-50 one (2024 ST_GAS -8.71) / THIS RUN one (2024 ST_GAS -8.23); C3a failing years keeper-3 one (2023 +11.0 %) / SPP-50 TWO (2023 +11.9, 2025 +11.6) / THIS RUN one (2025 +10.3); C3b failing years keeper-3 two (0.225, 0.233) / SPP-50 THREE (0.235, 0.239, 0.248) / THIS RUN one (2025 0.204). Against its OWN control -- lane SPP-50 (FINDING-spp-50-2026-09-08.md), the identical recipe without the field on the identical input surface -- it is BETTER ON EVERY CRITERION and worse on none. C2 / C4 / C6 / C8 PASS; C5a CO2 -2.4 / -1.8 / +3.1 %; D-10 free-class C1 11/12, all-class 15/16. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, unchanged from keeper-3. Remaining failures: C3c in all three years (model 0/4/2 h >$200 vs 42/59/68 actual) -- SPP has NO scarcity mechanism of any kind and that is SPP-55's object; C3a-2025 +10.3 % and C3b-2025 0.204, both MARGINAL misses of a +-10 % and a <=0.20 band and both improving; and the 2024 ST_GAS row, which is the Harrington fuel-vintage object (SPP-46 R-4), untouched by this lane. WHAT THE OWNER OVERRODE, recorded rather than smoothed: the mechanism FAILED its own pre-registered structural screen gate on 2025 and the lane reported that and recommended against promotion. G-1a predicted 871 interior-wind hours (band 348-2178) and measured 177; G-1b predicted 592 system-LW negative hours (band 237-1480) and measured 159; G-3 predicted the wind identity landing in 1.02-1.09 and it moved only 1.10681 -> 1.10489. A fourth gate, G-2, also failed as written (53.67 % vs 90 %) but was MIS-SPECIFIED by the lane -- it measured against the flat bound, which the mechanism moves in every hour by construction; the property it meant to test reads 100.0 % and is a diagnostic, never a gate pass. THE ROOT CAUSE, measured on the arm's own sidecars: the LP absorbs 98.2 % of the concentrated headroom by displacing thermal instead of spilling wind -- in the 2,848 allocated 2025 hours where wind did not go interior, thermal still had 8,200 MW of turn-down available, and the model's thermal ANNUAL MINIMUM is 254.3 MW across a ~40 GW fleet because SPP carries ZERO commitment floors and ZERO bridges. So the mechanism is NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT: it creates SPP's negative-price regime for the first time (229/214/159 system load-weighted hours < $0 against a control of essentially zero, pricing at EXACTLY -$26.00 where wind is marginal) but reaches only ~15-23 % of the ~1,000-1,170 measured negative hours. The binding limb is the thermal-commitment floor (SPP-51b R-2), and rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH] requires any successor floor to be RECONCILED with this allocation, never stacked on it -- this is also direct measured evidence AGAINST SPP-51b's own sizing note, which had placed the deficit on the wind side. Control for every later SPP lane = THIS bundle (rule 29(b) form 4), with the caveat that its bench is the repaired clock. Lever queue: SPP-51b R-2 (the thermal-commitment limb, now the measured binding constraint), then R-3 (the zonal spread, measured |N-S| 12.13/17.23/15.18 vs model ~1) and SPP-55 (scarcity / C3c). LINEAGE: SPP-40 -> SPP-42 -> SPP-43 (keeper-3) -> this run. Predecessors pruned under rule 15 keeper-only retention; their FINDING docs are retained and git history is the record. Records: FINDING-spp-51c-2026-09-09.md, PRECOMMIT-spp-51c-2026-09-09.md and its ADDENDUM (whose '6 h CST / 5 h CDT' reading of the clock offset is CORRECTED to a constant +6 by the FINDING, on a measurement against SPP's own GMT-stamped load in the DST months). RETENTION NOTE: predecessors are cited here by LANE and FINDING rather than by run id -- the same deliberate choice keeper-3's own note recorded -- because prune_iso_runs.py's citation guard scans this file's text, and a run id named here would be PROTECTED from rule 15's keeper-only retention and would later dangle. Nothing is hidden: the ids are in the FINDING docs, in the calibration log and in git history.
